tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Field. Outline of a part highlighted on a camera frame and fill of the Mac pointer. Same in every theme: it sits on photos and other apps, not on Tandrix surfaces. Always paired with highlight-halo and highlight-keyline.

tokens.name: highlight-halo
tokens.usage: Field. 4px white halo under every highlight outline and pointer, so it reads on dark frames.

tokens.name: highlight-keyline
tokens.usage: Field. 1px black keyline outside the halo, so it reads on bright frames and white app windows.

tokens.name: highlight-tint
tokens.usage: Field. Optional mask fill inside a highlighted part when SAM returns a mask.

tokens.name: overlay-ground
tokens.usage: Field. Ground of the Mac pointer caption, in-control indicator and highlight labels: these sit over other apps and photos, so they are the same in every theme.

tokens.name: overlay-ink
tokens.usage: Field. Text and icons on overlay-ground.

tokens.name: overlay-raised
tokens.usage: Field. Buttons and keycaps inside overlay-ground; overlay-ink on it is 13:1.

tokens.name: overlay-warn
tokens.usage: Field. 'Possible match' and other cautions inside overlay-ground; 12:1.

tokens.name: overlay-focus
tokens.usage: Field. Focus ring inside overlay-ground; 9:1.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Field. Dims a camera frame while Tandrix analyses it; overlay-ink sits on it.
